clauses.title: Zinc Coating – The
clauses.text: 3. Zinc Coating - The zinc coating shall conform to the requirement of any one of the grades prescribed in Table 2. The mass of coating referred to in this standard shall represent the total mass of zinc, both sides inclusive.

clauses.title: The following are recommended
clauses.text: 3.1 The following are recommended grades of zinc coating for the various thickness of sheets - Thickness Grade of mm Zinc Coating 0.18 to 0.28 (both inclusive) 200 0.30 to 0.55 (both inclusive) 220 0.63 to 1.0 (both inclusive) 275 above 1.00 mm 350 Note 1 - The recommended thickness for roofing applications is 0.63 mm and corresponding recommended grade of coating shall be minimum 275 gm/m2. Note 2 - If agreed to between the manufacture and the uprchaser for thickness 0.18 mm to 0.28 mm (both inclusive), other coating grades 180 and 120 may be used. clauses.title: Bend Test – Samples
clauses.text: 4. Bend Test - Samples of galvanized steel sheets shall withstand bending through 180º around a mandrel having diameter specified in Table 3 of the Standard without peeling or flaking of zinc coating. Crack or fracture of base metal, shall not be permitted. However, Cracks of the base metal developing at the edge of the specimen or coarse grain developing at the line of the bend shall be disregarded.

clauses.title: Coating Test
clauses.text: 5. Coating Test

clauses.title: Determination of Mass of
clauses.text: 5.1 Determination of Mass of Zinc Coating - The average masses of zinc coating  shall conform to both the values specified in Table 2.

clauses.title: Freedom from Defects –
clauses.text: 6. Freedom from Defects -  Galvanized plain sheets, corrugated sheets and coils shall be reasonably flat and free from bare spots, holes, tears and other harmful defects.

clauses.title: Coils, however, may contain some abnormal
clauses.text: 6.1 Coils, however, may contain some abnormal imperfections which render a portion of the coil unusable since the imperfections in the coil cannot be removed as in the case with cut length.

clauses.title: Mass – See Table
clauses.text: 7. Mass -  See Table 4 of the Standard.

clauses.title: Dimensions and Tolerances of Plain Sheets/Coils.
clauses.text: 8. Dimensions and Tolerances of Plain Sheets/Coils.

clauses.title: Sizes of Plain Sheets
clauses.text: 8.1 Sizes of Plain Sheets a)  Length - 1 800,  2 200,  2 500,  2 800 and  3 000 mm b)  Width - 750, 900, 1 000 and 1 200 mm c) Thickness - 0.18, 0.22, 0.25, 0.28, 0.32, (uncoated 0.40, 0.45, 0.50, 0.55, 0.63, sheets) 0.70, 0.80, 0.90, 1.00,  and  1.60 mm. Note : Sheets for other sizes (length, width and thickness) may also be supplied subject tothe mutual agreement between the purchaser and the manufacturer.

clauses.title: Unless other wire agreed,
clauses.text: 8.2 Unless other wire agreed,  the internal diameter of sheet supplied coil shall be 450, 510 or 610 mm.

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 8.3 Tolerances

clauses.title: No sheet shall be
clauses.text: 8.3.1 No sheet shall be smaller in length than that specified. Tolerances on length on plus side shall be 15 mm or 0.5 percent of length whichever is greater.

clauses.title: The diagonal distance between opposite corners
clauses.text: 8.3.2 The diagonal distance between opposite corners of any sheet shall not differ by more than 20 mm.

clauses.title: No plain sheet shall
clauses.text: 8.3.3   No plain sheet shall be smaller in width than that specified. The positive tolerances on width shall be 10 mm.

clauses.title: Thickness
clauses.text: 8.3.4 Thickness  : The tolerance on thickness of sheet and coil shall be according to IS 1079+ or IS 513++.

clauses.title: Tolerance on Mass
clauses.text: 8.3.5 Tolerance on Mass  — The tolerance on mass of individual sheets calculated in accordance with Table 4 of the Standard shall be within ±10 percent and tolerance on mass of each bundle of sheet shall be ±5 percent.

clauses.title: Dimensions and Tolerances of Corrugated Sheets.
clauses.text: 9. Dimensions and Tolerances of Corrugated Sheets.

clauses.title: Length – The length
clauses.text: 9.1.1 Length - The length of the corrugated sheets shall be as follows - 1 800, 2 200, 2 500, 2 800, 3 000 and 3 050 mm

clauses.title: Depth and pitch of the corrugations
clauses.text: 9.1.2 Depth and pitch of the corrugations:  The depth and pitch of corrugation shall be as follows  (see Fig. 1 of the standard) Grade Depth of Pitch of Corrugation Corrugation mm mm A 17.5 75 B 12.5 75

clauses.title: Number of corrugations –
clauses.text: 9.1.3 Number of corrugations - The number of corrugations shall be 8, 10, 11 and 13 depending on the width of the sheet. The overall width of the corrugated sheet before and after corrugation shall as shown in Table 3.
